cases.given: The tasks share a release but have radically different consequence and reversibility.
cases.expect: Proportionate rigor with the irreversible boundary fully protected.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a binding protocol already specifies the exact controls
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A required tier cannot be lowered because of cost or deadline.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
One workflow contains low-consequence edits and an irreversible high-impact action.
cases.expect: The skill assigns distinct tiers, maps mandatory controls, protects the high-risk boundary, and reclassifies on new evidence.
cases.reject: The skill applies one average depth, sets total budget only, or uses SAFE everywhere without a risk analysis.
